_README: This is the control panel for the daily Meta Ads automation. Fill in every value marked TODO. All money values are in INR (whole rupees unless noted). The daily agent reads THIS file first, every run.

campaign._location_lock: HARD RULE — NEVER change the geo/location targeting of these ad sets. Lucknow ad set = Uttar Pradesh only; Chandigarh ad set = Punjab only. The agent only ever adds creatives; it must never edit targeting/geo.
campaign._note: New daily ads are created INSIDE the target ad sets, so they share each ad set's existing ~500 INR/day budget and inherit its targeting. The agent does not add budget without approval.

pages._note: When the primary page hits its Meta ad-limit (new ad shows effective_status WITH_ISSUES / 'ad limit reached'), relaunch the same creative on the fallback page. Use fallback_instagram_user_id (17841431028601139) for IG on Bihar-page ads — the primary page's IG (17841448483484680) is NOT accessible from the Bihar page. On 2026-07-17 the primary page hit its limit and Lucknow creatives 2 & 3 were relaunched on the Bihar page with its own IG (FB+IG).

supabase.count_query: select utm_term as adset_id, count(distinct phone_norm) as leads from public.meta_ad_leads where utm_campaign='120249797872700412' and (lead_ts at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = '<YYYY-MM-DD>' group by utm_term;
supabase.note: PRIMARY lead source. Leads mirrored from the Google Sheet via an Apps Script (see docs/LEADS_SUPABASE.md). Count = distinct phone per ad set per IST day. CPL = Meta spend / these deduped leads. Read live via Supabase execute_sql.
supabase.setup_status: Table + insert policy created 2026-07-19. PENDING: operator installs the Apps Script bridge on the sheet (docs/LEADS_SUPABASE.md) so rows start flowing. Until data arrives, fall back to Meta Website leads and note it.

leads_source.cross_check: meta_website_leads (ads_get_ad_entities results/cost_per_result on campaign 120249797872700412). Use as fallback until Supabase has data, and to sanity-check the sheet count.

secondary_google_sheet.status: UNRELIABLE via Drive connector — the CSV/read export is cached and lagged badly (stuck at 16 Jul, row count went 254->251). Do NOT use it for lead counts or red flags. Only use it (if ever) to pull a lead's contact details, and treat freshness with suspicion.

leads_source._incident: 2026-07-17/18: cached sheet showed 0 leads and triggered a FALSE 'form down' alarm, but Meta showed 0 leads on 17 Jul (real, brief outage) and 9 leads on 18 Jul (recovered). Lesson: Meta is the source of truth for lead counts.
leads_source.operator_preference: Operator wants lead counts taken from the LEAD SHEET (title 'Delhi Photography Workshop - Leads') with DUPLICATES REMOVED (dedupe by normalised Phone; fall back to Email). BLOCKER: the sheet cannot be read fresh from this automation environment — the Drive connector serves a 3-day-stale cached export, and direct HTTPS fetch of Google is network-blocked (403). Sheet modifiedTime confirms it IS live. PENDING DECISION (A/B/both): A = report leads from Meta Website leads now; B = mirror the form leads into Supabase/Notion (readable live here) then count from there with phone-dedupe. Until B is set up, use Meta (A).

creatives._note: CITY-LOCKED: a Lucknow ad set may ONLY use images from the Lucknow folder; Chandigarh ONLY from the Chandigarh folder. Never cross them. Each ad set's creatives_folder_id (in campaign.target_ad_sets) is authoritative.

monitoring._note: Every day the agent REPORTS CPL per ad set for ALL campaigns below, not just the lead campaign.

report_campaigns.name: Lead Campaign - Lucknow Workshop
report_campaigns.comment: CPL per ad set from Meta results (Website leads) + cost_per_result — matches Ads Manager, live. Do NOT use the Google Sheet (Drive export is cached/unreliable).

report_campaigns.name: New Leads campaign (messaging / conversations)
report_campaigns.comment: Messaging conversations do NOT land in the Google Sheet. Read them STRAIGHT FROM META's dashboard metrics: `results` = messaging conversations started, `cost_per_result` = cost per conversation. Do NOT use cost_per_lead or derive from spend — that gave a wrong number (₹407/2 vs the true ₹81.37/10 on 2026-07-16).

red_flag_alerts._note: CRITICAL alerts. When any condition below is true, send a 🚨 RED FLAG WhatsApp message to the Seminar Daily Reporting group IMMEDIATELY (separate from the normal daily report) and also email it. Do NOT bury a critical issue inside the daily summary.
red_flag_alerts.health_check_cadence: every 3h at 11:00, 14:00, 17:00, 20:00, 23:00 Asia/Kolkata (cron '30 5,8,11,14,17 * * *' UTC) — alerts only, silent when healthy

conditions.trigger: Base this on META's Website leads (results), NOT the Google Sheet. If the lead campaign spent > ~₹300 in a full day but Meta reports 0 Website leads (results) for that day, the form/pixel is likely broken. Do NOT use the Google Sheet for this check — the Drive export is cached/stale and caused a FALSE 'no leads' alarm on 17-18 Jul.
conditions.meaning: Form / landing-page pixel likely broken — money spent, no leads.

conditions.trigger: Any judged ad set CPL > cpl_rules.hard_ceiling_cpl_inr (₹120).
Messaging cost_per_result rises > 50% vs the prior day.
A live ad returns effective_status DISAPPROVED / WITH_ISSUES not explained by the known page ad-limit fallback.
Daily spend on any ad set is > 2x its configured daily budget (possible runaway).
The WhatsApp sender account is disconnected (status CREDENTIALS) — then send via email and note it.

image_hosting._note: Meta CANNOT fetch Google Drive links directly, and the Meta connector has no image-upload tool. Bridge: the agent decodes each Drive creative locally (never through the model context) and commits it to this PUBLIC repo under creatives/, then hands Meta the raw.githubusercontent.com URL, which Meta CAN fetch. Proven working 2026-07-17.
image_hosting.repo_is_public_warning: Because this repo is public, config.json (ad account / campaign IDs, landing URL) is publicly visible. Consider moving creative hosting to a dedicated public repo and making this config repo private.

autonomous_then_inform: Launch / add new ad creatives into an ad set.
Pause (switch OFF) an under-performing ad or creative.
Pause (switch OFF) an under-performing ad SET.
Any other within-account optimisation that does NOT raise spend.
requires_operator_approval_first: INCREASING any budget (e.g. 2x/3x an ad set or campaign budget) — always take the operator's consideration first.
rules.safety_confirm_first: Before switching OFF the LAST active ad set in a campaign (which would stop ALL delivery for that city), confirm with the operator first.
rules.daily_report: ALWAYS sent every morning — per ad set: spend, leads, CPL (lead campaign) and spend, conversations, cost/conversation (messaging). Plus which ad sets/creatives are winning and what was optimised.

schedule._note: Daily Routine fires 09:10 IST. If a fired run ever reports connectors missing, recreate the Routine from claude.ai -> Routines UI with Meta/Drive/Gmail/Unipile attached (guaranteed).
